website_notes: Confirmed identity: this is the government-built "Turkish Hospital" (also called Saida Governmental Emergency/Trauma Hospital), funded by a $20M grant from Turkey via TIKA, inaugurated in 2010, specializing in trauma/burns/emergency care. Multiple credible sources (L'Orient Today, Daily Sabah, TIKA.gov.tr, MOPH Lebanon) confirm it as a public/governmental facility that has historically operated only intermittently (e.g., during COVID-19 and after the 2020 Beirut port explosion) rather than as a fully-opened hospital. No distinct official website domain exists; the facility is represented only via the Lebanese Ministry of Public Health site (moph.gov.lb, multiple listing pages) and a Facebook page (facebook.com/turkishhospitalsaida/). This is an honest 'no official website' outcome consistent with a government-run facility.
careers_notes: As a public/governmental hospital, this facility does not have its own distinct careers page or ATS. Hiring for Lebanese governmental hospitals of this type is expected to route through the Ministry of Public Health's general 'Job Opportunities' page (moph.gov.lb) and/or the Syndicate of Hospitals in Lebanon job board (syndicateofhospitals.org.lb/JobOpportunities/), rather than a facility-specific portal. No hospital-specific careers page, email, or ATS was found, so this is recorded as unavailable_not_found with context rather than a bare non-result.
linkedin_notes: A LinkedIn company page titled 'Turkish Hospital' (linkedin.com/company/turkish-hospital) appeared in search results, but a follow-up search confirmed this corresponds to a Turkish Hospital in Doha, Qatar (matching turkishhospitals.com, which has its own careers page), not the Saida, Lebanon facility. No LinkedIn company page specific to the Saida Turkish/Governmental Emergency Hospital was found; only a Facebook page (facebook.com/turkishhospitalsaida/) exists for this entity.
